info.title: onemedia
info.description: The onemedia command line tool: inspect media containers (and, as the library grows, edit tags, remux, trim, repair and package them). Containers, metadata, subtitles; no decoding (subtitles are planned and not in this preview). Unaffiliated with other products or companies named OneMedia.

commands.name: info
commands.description: format, duration, tracks and defects of a media file
